slides.title: Weather & Climate ☀️
slides.text: Weather is the day-to-day condition of the atmosphere (sunny, rainy, windy). Climate is the average weather over 30+ years. Weather elements include temperature (thermometer, °C), rainfall (rain gauge, mm), wind, humidity, and sunshine. Weather affects what we wear and do each day!
slides.spoken: Weather is what happens day to day, while climate is the long-term pattern over many years. We measure temperature with a thermometer and rainfall with a rain gauge!

slides.title: Importance of Plants 🌱
slides.text: Plants give us oxygen through photosynthesis, food (rice, fruits, vegetables), timber, medicine (neem, tulsi), and fibre (cotton, jute). Their roots hold soil and prevent soil erosion. Land plants like banyan and neem grow on soil, while aquatic plants like lotus and algae grow in water!
slides.spoken: Plants give us oxygen, food, medicine, and prevent soil erosion with their strong roots. Land plants grow on soil, while aquatic plants like lotus grow in water!

slides.title: Importance of Animals & Habitats 🐄
slides.text: Animals provide food (milk, eggs), labour (bullocks ploughing), wool, silk, and manure. Bees pollinate flowers and birds disperse seeds. Land animals (cows, tigers) live on soil, aquatic animals (fish, turtles) live in water, and some like frogs live in both. This balance keeps ecosystems healthy!
slides.spoken: Animals give us milk, wool, and labour, and help plants through pollination and seed dispersal. Land animals live on soil, aquatic animals live in water, and frogs live in both!

slides.title: Healthy Food Combinations 🍛
slides.text: Foods are grouped by function: body-building (proteins like dal, milk, eggs), energy-giving (carbohydrates like rice, wheat, potatoes), and protective (vitamins and minerals like fruits, vegetables). A balanced Indian thali has all three groups in the right proportions. Avoid junk food — it lacks nutrients!
slides.spoken: A healthy Indian thali combines energy-giving rice, body-building dal, and protective vegetables. A balanced diet has all food groups in the right proportions. Avoid junk food!

slides.title: Buildings in the Locality 🏫
slides.text: Community buildings serve our daily needs: school for education, health centre/hospital for medical care, post office for letters and parcels, police station for safety, bank for money, and market for goods. We can draw simple maps of our locality using symbols to show where these buildings stand near roads and homes!
slides.spoken: Schools teach us, hospitals heal us, post offices keep us connected, and banks keep our money safe. We can draw simple maps to show where these buildings are in our community!

challenges.question: What is the main difference between WEATHER and CLIMATE?
challenges.answer: Weather is day-to-day condition, climate is average pattern over many years
options: Weather is day-to-day condition, climate is average pattern over many years
Weather and climate are exactly the same thing
Weather is measured over years, climate is daily
challenges.hint: Think about time scale: one changes overnight, the other takes thirty years or more!
challenges.misconception: Weather and climate are NOT the same! Weather is the short-term day-to-day condition of the atmosphere, whereas climate is the average weather pattern measured over thirty years or more.

challenges.question: Why are plants important for the environment and living things?
challenges.answer: They give oxygen, food, shelter, and prevent soil erosion
options: They give oxygen, food, shelter, and prevent soil erosion
They cause air pollution and take up space
They have no use for animals or humans
challenges.hint: Think about what green leaves release during photosynthesis and what roots do in soil!
challenges.misconception: Plants are essential! They give us oxygen through photosynthesis, food, timber, medicine, and their roots hold soil firmly to prevent soil erosion.

Only chocolate and soft drinks
Only potato chips and candy

challenges.misconception: Eating only junk food or sweets lacks proteins and vitamins! A healthy combination (balanced diet) combines energy foods (rice), body-building proteins (dal), and protective vegetables.
